description_en: Queries the metadata of a secret
description_zh: 查询凭据的元数据信息
name: DescribeSecret

parameters.help_zh:
凭据名称或凭据资源名称（ARN）。

访问其他阿里云账号下的凭据时，必须输入凭据ARN。凭据ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:secret/${secret-name}`
parameters.name: secret_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the resource tags of the secret. Valid values:

true: The resource tags are returned.
false: The resource tags are not returned. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否在返回参数中包含凭据的资源标签。取值：  

true：包含资源标签。 

false（默认值）：不包含资源标签
parameters.name: fetch_tags

Arn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the secret

AutomaticRotation.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic rotation is enabled. Valid values:

Enabled: indicates that automatic rotation is enabled.
Disabled: indicates that automatic rotation is disabled.
Invalid: indicates that the status of automatic rotation is abnormal. In this case, Secrets Manager cannot automatically rotate the secret.

This parameter is returned only for a managed ApsaraDB RDS secret, a managed RAM secret, or a managed ECS secret
AutomaticRotation.description_zh:
是否开启自动轮转。取值：

Enabled：开启自动轮转。
Disabled：不开启自动轮转。
Invalid：轮转状态异常，KMS无法为您自动轮转。

仅RDS凭据、PolarDB凭据、RAM凭据或ECS凭据返回该参数

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the secret was created

DKMSInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated KMS instance

EncryptionKeyId.description_en: The ID of the customer master key (CMK) that is used to encrypt the secret value
EncryptionKeyId.description_zh: 加密凭据值的KMS密钥的标识符

ExtendedConfig.description_en:
The extended configuration of the secret.

This parameter is returned only for a managed ApsaraDB RDS secret, a managed Resource Access Management (RAM) secret, or a managed Elastic Compute Service (ECS) secret
ExtendedConfig.description_zh:
凭据的拓展配置。  
仅RDS凭据、RAM凭据、PolarDB凭据或ECS凭据返回该参数

LastRotationDate.description_en:
The time when the last rotation was performed.

This parameter is returned if the secret was rotated
LastRotationDate.description_zh:
最近一次轮转的时间。

当凭据发生过轮转时返回该参数

NextRotationDate.description_en:
The time when the next rotation will be performed.

This parameter is returned when automatic rotation is enabled
NextRotationDate.description_zh:
下一次轮转的时间。

当开启自动轮转时，返回该参数

PlannedDeleteTime.description_en: The time when the secret is scheduled to be deleted

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RotationInterval.description_en:
The interval for automatic rotation.

The value is in the `integer[unit]` format. `integer` indicates the length of time. `unit`: indicates the time unit. The value of `unit` is fixed as s. For example, if the value is 604800s, automatic rotation is performed at a 7-day interval.

This parameter is returned when automatic rotation is enabled
RotationInterval.description_zh:
凭据自动轮转的周期。    
格式为`integer[unit]`，其中`integer`表示时间长度，`unit`表示时间单位。 `unit`取值：s（秒）。例如：7天的轮转周期为604800s。

当开启自动轮转时，返回该参数

SecretType.description_en:
The type of the secret. Valid values:

Generic: indicates a generic secret.
Rds: indicates a managed ApsaraDB RDS secret.
RAMCredentials: indicates a managed RAM secret.
ECS: indicates a managed ECS secret
SecretType.description_zh:
凭据类型。取值：
Generic：通用凭据。  
Rds：RDS凭据。  
RAMCredentials：RAM凭据。  
ECS：ECS凭据。
PolarDB：PolarDB凭据

Tag.description_en:
The resource tags of the secret.

This parameter is not returned if you set the FetchTags parameter to false or you do not specify the FetchTags parameter
Tag.description_zh:
凭据的资源标签。
如果入参FetchTags取值为false或者未指定，则不返回该参数

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the secret was updated
